notes:
Summary: BridgePoint builds a ticket-automation layer sold to mid-market SaaS and ecomm support orgs. Primary ask: reliable ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging for routing and macros. Interested in improving agent TTR and auto-resolve rate.

Key points / snippets from calls:
- "needs consistent tags for routing to L2 — 'billing', 'technical', 'security'" (quote from Head of Support, 11/05).
- Prefers integration into Zendesk/Freshdesk workflows (macros, triggers, webhooks). Wants generated summary to populate "internal_summary" field and suggested tags to attach as tags + ticket field updates.
- Tool-calling use case: if tag == "billing_refund" then call internal refunds service via webhook / trigger macro. Wants Redwood to call external tool hooks (safe, auditable).

Performance / reliability needs:
- Typical steady-state: 70-150 tickets/min across region, peak spikes during product incidents up to 600 req/s for classification/summaries (very short window).
- Latency SLO for summarization endpoint: 95th percentile < 250ms; classification/tagging < 120ms.
- Cost sensitive: targeting <$0.03 per ticket processed for summarization+tagging at scale; wants Optimize suggestions for batching + KV cache to reduce token cost.

Model & routing preferences:
- Preference for open-source, quantized models for cost control but must have fallbacks to higher-quality variant when summarization confidence low.
- Want automatic routing/fallback: cheaper model for low-risk tickets, higher-quality for flagged sensitive content.
- Proposal: Redwood Dedicated pool with VPC peering to handle PI/PII tickets and hosted fallbacks for non-sensitive.

Security & compliance:
- SOC2 required; SSO/SAML for console; audit logs for every tool call + tag decision; key management (KMS).
- Data residency: EU tenant for EMEA customers, retention controls per customer settings.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Auto-tag precision top-3 >= 90% on a 5k ticket holdout set.
- Summaries: 2-4 sentence internal-summary capturing root cause + suggested next step 85%+ F1 against labeled dataset.
- System handles 600 req/s burst with <=5% error rate and no SLA violations during test window.

Notes on integrations / artifacts:
- Zendesk macros need mapping table (we will provide current macros CSV).
- Freshdesk sandbox requested from their EngOps; delays are blocking POC issuance.
- Legal: want explicit data residency clause + audit log retention period (3 years max) in contract.

Short-term next steps (action items):
- SE deliver infra diagram + batching config (Diego) — due 2025-12-20.
- Provide Freshdesk sandbox access or sample dataset (BridgePoint EngOps).
- Legal to confirm acceptable wording for data residency clause (BridgePoint Legal).

CRM fragments / quick bits:
- interested in Redwood Optimize for quantization/batching suggestions.
- "Can you show us spike test reports from other Retail customers?" — asked on demo.
- Follow-up Q: telemetry: token-level breakdown per route + tag-level confusion matrix.
